page.layout: Two columns side by side, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: entries from "Niph. 3. f. m. R." to "allicient te, fut. Pi-". Right column: continuation "el, 3. pl. m." to the end, with a small Hebrew letter heading mid-column. Running heads (Hebrew letters) at top left and top right. Page number top right. Signature "Z" bottom left, catchword bottom right.

main_text.l: וַיִּפְרְצֵנִי & disrupit me, fut. Piel, gem. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. פּוּר[?].
יִפְרַק rumpet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. פָּרַק.
יְפָרֵשׁ expandet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. פָּרַשׂ.
יִפְרְשׂוּ expandent, fut. Kal, יִפָּרְשׂוּ expandentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. פָּרַשׂ.
יָפַת pulchra, יָפָה & pulchra, יָפַתִּי pulchra mea, יָפוֹת pulchræ, יָפוֹת & pulchræ; sing fæm. constr. aff. & pl. fæm. No. יָפָה; Rad. יָפָה pulchrum esse.
וַיִּפְתְּ & pellectus est, fut. Kal, יִפְתְּ dilatet; fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יַפְתֶּה, & יַפְתְּ) Rad. פָּתַח.
יִפָּתֶה pellectus erit, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. פָּתַה.
יְפַתֶּךָּ allicient te, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. פָּתָה.
el, 3. pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יְפַתְּנָה; Rad. פָּתָה.
main_text.head: י צ
main_text.l: יֵצְאוּ egredietur, יֵצְאוּ egredientur, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָצָא.
וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ & fecerunt exire eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָצָא.
יֹצְאִים illi exeuntes, וְיֹצְאוֹת illæ exeuntes, &c. Ben. Kal, pl. masc. & fæm. Rad. יָצָא.
יָצֵב constituet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָצַב.
יַצִּיג statuet, יַצִּיגוּ statuent, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. יָצַג.
יָצַג constitutus est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. R. יָצַג.
יְצוּדֶנָּה venabitur eam, fut. Kal, 3. f. m aff. R. צוּד.
וַיְצַו & mandavit, יְצַוֶּם mandabit eis, יְצַוּוּ mandabunt, &c. fut. Piel, 3. f. m. (pro יְצַוָּה) & aff. & 3. pl. m. R. צִוָּה.

page.notes: Hebrew forms and Rad. roots in the left column (for example the first Hebrew form in the "disrupit me" entry and the root after "Rad.") are only partly legible at this resolution; they are marked [?] where doubtful. The left-column continuation "el, 3. pl. m." and the Hebrew forms in the right column are transcribed from the scan and may contain small errors. The short Hebrew letter heading mid-right column is treated as a level 3 heading. Printed words in the entries (e.g. "Ben.", "apoc.", "Rad.") are copied as printed.
